help.title: OECD Ecotoxicology Test Suite
help.body:
Description
Complete ecotoxicological analysis for three OECD aquatic test guidelines.
  • TG 203 – Fish Acute Toxicity → LC10, LC50, NOEC/LOEC
  • TG 202 – Daphnia Immobilisation → EC10, EC50, NOEC/LOEC
  • TG 201 – Algal Growth Inhibition → ErC10/20/50, EyC50, NOEC/LOEC
TG201 Algae notes:
• Mean Control Growth Rate (µC) is auto-calculated from the rows where concentration = 0. You do NOT need to enter it manually.
• Drag the 0-hour column into "Biomass at Start (X0)".
• Drag the final timepoint column (72h or 96h) into "Biomass at End (Xn)".
• Select Test Duration matching your end timepoint: 3 days = 72h, 4 days = 96h.

TG203 Fish notes:
Each dead column = ADDITIONAL (incremental) deaths found in THAT observation period only.
The code computes cumulative totals by summing across periods.
E.g., drag the column of fish found dead at the 24h check into the "0–24h" slot, and the column of new deaths found at the 96h check into the "72–96h" slot.

Dataset requirements:
• Concentration must be NUMERIC (no "ppm" text).
• Control rows must have concentration = 0 (not blank).
• No average/mean rows — replicate rows only.
• Header in row 1, data from row 2.

R Packages required: drc, multcomp, MASS, magrittr
